author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at how the modding community has received some very broad rules that put an age old practice for one of the most modded franchises in what I think some real jeopardy. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: Rockstar Games Is Already Going After Modding Again...
